thread:
Maria (CSM): quick alert — Mulberry's API usage dropped ~60% WoW for the pilot org. Saw the falloff on 2026-03-08, mostly from the /v1/generate route. Dan mentioned a new ML lead is evaluating another inference vendor. we should triage renewal risk.
Jalen (AM): thanks for flagging. when's their renewal window? any contract levers? :thinking_face:
Maria (CSM): renewal window mid-May. no committed seats, on pay-as-you-go. billing looks healthy but activity is concentrated to two users.
Priya (Solutions Eng): can you paste the minimal query you ran? want to check latency/4xx spikes. sometimes a client config change kills traffic.
Maria (CSM): query dump from UsageBot: ```SELECT route, count(*) AS calls, week FROM usage WHERE account='mulberry' GROUP BY route, week ORDER BY week DESC; /v1/generate: 240 (last week) -> 600 (prev week)```
UsageBot: automated note — anomaly detected: -59% calls on /v1/generate for account mulberry between 1719000000 and 1719600000.
Dan Mulberry (CTO): yep, new ML lead (Alex) arrived 3/7 and they started a re-eval. they ran a perf test vs another provider and liked the latency/cost math there. we weren't told in advance.
Jalen (AM): ok. two angles: 1) immediate salvage to keep integration live, 2) competitive re-engage for the renewal. Maria — can you confirm which apps lost traffic (dev vs prod)?
Maria (CSM): seems dev and a staging account lost most calls. production usage steady but low. suspect they flipped routing in staging to alternate provider for eval.
Priya (Solutions Eng): action: let's offer a focused perf follow-up. propose a 30m bench session where we replicate their seq lengths and batch sizes. I can run kernel-level traces if they allow.
Jalen (AM): agree. I'll own the commercial touch with Dan and Alex. plan: schedule perf bench w/ Priya this week, offer 90-day discounted dedicated capacity trial to neutralize cost objections, and propose a short tech QBR before renewal.
Maria (CSM): will send a short outreach note to Dan/ Alex with calendar options + a one-pager showing recent latency/cost numbers and our PoC offer. tagging @Priya for availability.
Dan Mulberry (CTO): that's helpful. Alex — are you ok for a bench session tomorrow?
Alex (Mulberry ML lead): yes, tomorrow 2pm PT works. want to see real inference traces and batching behavior.
Priya (Solutions Eng): booked 2pm PT. I'll bring a short checklist: model size, seq dist, batch sizes, quantization settings, and a quick tail latency plot.
Maria (CSM): next steps captured: 1) bench session 2pm PT (Priya) 2) AM commercial offer (Jalen) 3) CSM one-pager + outreach (Maria) 4) capture any config differences in staging. will update thread after session. :white_check_mark:
